entity.sourceWork: Cuphead: The Delicious Last Course (2022), Ms. Chalice Super Art II — Shield Pal
entity.appearance: Small pointed golden shield, red-pink heart inset with two black oval/pie-cut eyes, two complete white feathered wings at the upper sides, black cartoon ink outline. No arms, legs, mouth, insect body, Chalice body, generic blue energy bubble or empty force-field ring.

sourceLinks.observation: Ms.Chalice archive submitted August17,2022. Actual mc_super_II_shield_loop_0051 and heart_death0001/0013/0026 PNG references downloaded by byte ranges, decompressed with CRC verification and viewed.
Shield Pal is a flying golden shield with heart emblem, staying until the next damaging hit; no HP loss on that hit.
Ms.Chalice SuperArtII summons a familiar that takes one extra hit.

arrival.description: Four complete distinct wing-flap arrival poses.

guard.description: Four distinct full familiar hover/flap poses; loop persists without a timer until one accepted damaging hit.

absorb.description: Four distinct complete familiar squash/recoil/tilt poses acknowledging one accepted damaging hit; no HP, healing, attack or invented limb.

departure.description: Four distinct complete familiar withdrawal/tilt/folding wing poses before disappearing. Whole shield/heart/wings remain contained in every frame.

authoredAdaptation: New pixel-art drawings, not official frames. The source hit/departure references distort and disperse the heart; the bounded engine withdraws a complete familiar before hiding it so every retained native cell has the whole source entity. Timings .4s arrival/.56s guard loop/.4s absorb/.4s departure are explicit engine sampling, not certified source timings.
